ideas.pitch: An AI-powered festive greeting and custom hamper generator leveraging Adaption AI to create hyper-personalized video greetings and curated gifting portfolios.
ideas.title: AdaptionFest: AI Diwali Gift & Greeting Customizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the Diwali context of the buildathon while heavily demonstrating deep integration with the mandatory Adaption AI platform.

ideas.pitch: A solo developer and student focused AI mentor that generates hyper-customized 48-hour learning roadmaps and tracks execution milestones using Adaption AI.
ideas.title: AdaptionPrep: Individual AI Study and Skill Sprint Planner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate pain point for students and developers participating in fast-paced individual hackathons like CodeDia.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent that tracks seasonal spending, optimizes festival gifting budgets, and automatically drafts negotiation or purchasing strategies.
ideas.title: AdaptionExpense: Festive Budget and Gifting Intelligence Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines practical utility with agentic workflows, showcasing a live working prototype that appeals to everyday consumer problems during festive seasons.

ideas.pitch: A specialized developer tool that reads runtime error logs from hackathon projects and uses Adaption AI to write, test, and inject patches directly into the codebase.
ideas.title: AdaptionTriage: Solo Dev Bug Resolver & Error Diagnostics Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting developer productivity tools at a hackathon resonates strongly with judges who are fellow developers and organizers experiencing the exact same build-time pain.

ideas.pitch: A low-latency voice-interactive AI companion built using Adaption AI to help busy hackathon participants manage stress, plan breaks, and practice mindfulness routines.
ideas.title: AdaptionRitual: Voice-Guided Festive Wellness & Mindfulness Companion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Voice-first interfaces create incredible, memorable live demo moments during 24-48 hour judging presentations.
